DO_NOT_CITE: Every number below is an artefact of contaminated identity labels, not a property of the model. Retained as the record of a discarded attempt.
retraction_reason: Subject images were gathered from Wikimedia Commons by name search, which returns files that merely MENTION a name. Several subjects' sets are therefore mostly other people: genuine_min is NEGATIVE for five of six subjects, and a person cannot score -0.128 against himself. The by_gender_frr split below (f 0.895 vs m 0.177) tracks how contaminated each subject's set happened to be -- the female subjects kept 3-5 usable images each against 12 for the least contaminated male subject -- and is NOT evidence that the system fails more for women.
what_is_claimed_instead: Per-identity false rejects on LFW, where the directory IS the label: calibration/per_identity.json. Demographic performance remains unmeasured and ETHICS.md section 6 names it as the project's largest open limitation.
note: Per-subject and gender grouping only. Race/ethnicity is NOT inferred from faces; the subject set was chosen to be more varied than the original pair, but this is not a NIST-style audit on a labelled benchmark.
